title: NTP Stratum Hierarchy
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: A vis-network tree from stratum 0 reference clocks through stratum 1 and 2 servers to a Pico W, with node info, a step-through NTP request showing T1-T4, and a network delay slider.

learningObjectives: Explain how time flows from atomic clocks through NTP strata to a Pico W client
Explain how network delay limits NTP accuracy

keyQuestions: What does the stratum number mean?
Why is the error limited to about half the round trip?
commonMisconceptions: A stratum 1 server always gives a more accurate result than a nearby stratum 2 server
The Pico gets time directly from an atomic clock
assessmentOpportunities: Compute the worst-case error for a 100 ms round trip
